fields.description: Vida Residences brings one to three bedroom apartments and three-bedroom townhouses to a park-facing setting in Dubai Hills Estate. Shared spaces are designed around everyday social life, with pools, exercise areas and places to meet outdoors. The apartments and duplex townhouses offer different ways to use the address, from a compact home to a layout with a private terrace and separate upstairs bedrooms.

overview: The brochure places emphasis on open living spaces, natural materials and a restrained, warm interior palette. Shared facilities include places for quiet time as well as social gatherings, from the landscaped podium to barbecue and pool areas. Dubai Hills Park, the mall and the golf club form part of the wider neighbourhood; access to an external facility should not be read as a membership included with the home.
research.locationNote: The development overlooks Dubai Hills Park within Dubai Hills Estate. The mall and business park are nearby, while Al Khail Road connects the district with other parts of Dubai. Check the exact unit’s orientation and surrounding buildings before relying on a park-view description.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 1.6m. The March 2024 launch sheet lists starts of AED 1.6m, AED 3m and AED 4.1m for one, two and three bedrooms, and AED 5.9m for townhouses. These figures do not establish current availability or a resale asking price.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule has ten equal 10% stages: 90% before estimated completion and 10% at completion. The construction milestones below follow the payment PDF. Outstanding payments for an individual purchase must be confirmed separately.
research.handoverNote: The Emaar-branded launch payment sheet estimates August 2028. Bayut instead lists Q4 2027. This page uses the documentary launch estimate, not a confirmed current delivery commitment; obtain the latest contractual programme.

facts.label: Published development scale
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 209 apartments and eight townhouses: 217 homes in total. It describes a 23-storey building; these are project totals, not homes available for sale.

facts.label: Townhouse arrangement
facts.value: Type 1A places one bedroom, the maid’s room and living space downstairs, with two bedrooms upstairs. TH02, TH04 and TH06 have a 2,034.59 sq ft suite plus 528.19 sq ft of outdoor area, totalling 2,562.78 sq ft.

facts.label: Apartment outdoor area
facts.value: Three-bedroom unit 104 totals 2,115.11 sq ft, including 562.95 sq ft of balcony. A larger total can therefore reflect outdoor space rather than a comparable increase in the internal rooms.

facts.label: Portal figures require care
facts.value: Bayut’s townhouse size range differs substantially from the official plans, and its completion date is earlier. The unit table uses Emaar’s printed total areas rather than those portal figures.
